criteria: RIGHT anatomical hand carries lotus lamp, LEFT carries jade flask; trace shoulder/elbow/sleeve/wrist, do not use screen left/right alone.
Follow hip-knee-ankle-toe travel plane; distinguish hip occlusion, normal knee flexion and plantar flexion from transverse foot yaw.
Keep natural flexion and weight shift; do not force locked knees.
A visible sole alone neither proves an error nor clears the entire group.
Run16x75ms unchanged; hit240/attack360/cast720 unchanged; no export/input/cleanup operations.
limitations: Static visual audit with current-source contact provenance verified; no new browser/client dynamic acceptance by this agent.
Many hips and upper legs are hidden by costume. Suspected axis cases remain explicit; no claim all100 are anatomically certified.
Contact-scale slots have lower detail confidence than native focused slots.
